description: Estimate the employee count band of a company from its website domain. Give domain (for example linear.app) or domains (up to 500, one per item, Name | domain.com to pass a name). Each domain returns one row: employee_band (1-10, 11-50, 51-200, 201-500, 501-1000, 1001-5000, 5001-10000, or 10001+), employee_band_min and employee_band_max, an exact employee_count when Wikidata or the homepage gives one, estimate_source (linkedin_search_snippet: the LinkedIn company size as Google prints it in its results, matched by the website the result shows; wikidata; or homepage_structured_data), a 0 to 1 confidence, sources_agree, and context columns (GitHub public members, open jobs). No request goes to linkedin.com. Rows with no size come back free with row_status no_data. A run that does not succeed is returned as an error with its run ID. Read-only; requires an APIFY_TOKEN; Apify charges per estimated company.

company_name.description: The company name for that one domain. Empty: read from the homepage.

domain.description: One company website domain, for example linear.app. A URL or an email address also works.

domains.description: Up to 500 domains. Write Name | domain.com to pass the name too.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before any row that would take its charges over this amount.

skip_cache.description: true reads every source again instead of returning a row estimated in the last 7 days (cached rows are free). Default false.

sources.description: Sources to check. Empty: all. github and jobs need homepage.

name: estimate_company_headcount
title: Estimate company headcount
